subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should OpenClaw accept this grouped replacement of executable action code in token-, secret-, release-, security-, and agent-bearing workflows once the exact head is green?
rationale: Official commit identity and source compatibility can be checked mechanically, but accepting the combined supply-chain boundary and operational blast radius requires repository-owner intent.

options.title: Approve after exact-head validation
options.body: Refresh the Dependabot head, require the full workflow/security gate to pass, then approve the verified immutable pins as one coordinated update.

options.title: Split sensitive action families
options.body: Separate Codex, token, Docker publishing, CodeQL, and routine setup-action bumps so each security boundary can be validated and reverted independently.

options.title: Pause the grouped update
options.body: Leave the current pins in place until Dependabot access is stable and maintainers have capacity to validate the broad automation surface.

recommendation.title: Approve after exact-head validation
recommendation.body: Refresh the Dependabot head, require the full workflow/security gate to pass, then approve the verified immutable pins as one coordinated update.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available history signal spans the affected agent workflows, Docker release automation, and GitHub Actions modernization.
